outcome: non-HMOs metabolite concentrations (including glutamate, glutamine, o-phosphocholine, citrate, sn-glycero-phosphocholine)
cohort: The study included milk samples from 129 lactating Chinese women within 1 year postpartum.
finding: Metabolomic analysis of human milk revealed significant variations of HMOs, but not non-HMOs, based on secretor status, and changes in certain HMOs and non-HMOs concentrations were observed over the 1 year of lactation.
mod_finding: Delivery mode did not affect both HMOs and non-HMOs concentrations.
